domain.notes: Starter template — power utility arrears recovery, India

datasets.name: Disconnection disputes
datasets.description: Consumers disputing disconnection with an 'already paid' claim. The submitted receipt is verified against recovery.payments; the same identifiers clearing multiple cases is the 'new tenant' entity signal.

columns.name: consumer_id
columns.description: Consumer number — the cross-case linkable key

columns.name: receipt_url
columns.description: Submitted payment proof — pinned: ONLY this document feeds the ledger check

columns.name: id_proof_url
columns.description: Consumer's ID proof ('new tenant' claims). ROLE identity = resubmission by the same person is VERIFICATION, never a duplicate flag — but the same ID clearing OTHER premises still links via identity_fields.

datasets.name: Billing payments ledger
datasets.description: Posted consumer payments, receipt-keyed — the system of record every disconnection-dispute payment proof verifies against.

columns.name: collection_mode
columns.description: counter / online / field-agent cash — field-agent rows with no ledger match are the agent-side fraud tell
